description: RR and RD of each factor within each combination of the other factors
population: CRSS 2016-2024; unit and population per analysis (see multifactor/analyses)
method: Survey logistic model with all factor main effects, a product for every combination of non-reference factor levels (unknown included), and categorical covariates; standardised margins for all 2^k combinations (g-computation over the analysis population); Taylor linearisation on 25 strata / 67 PSUs (t, 42 df); cells with < 30 units or < 10 events withheld; Holm across the registered family per scale
